comparison_policy.within_version: ADMISSIBLE only when model and target results share benchmark, DatasetRealization, evaluation identity, target QOI, prediction semantics, and exactly aligned prediction row keys
comparison_policy.cross_version: Copy all 36 RES-281 decisions without relaxation; no cross-version scores or rankings are calculated
comparison_policy.missing_historical_model_evaluations: UNSUPPORTED_BY_EVIDENCE; never impute from public-native IID results

candidate_policy.temporal_expert: Keep each of three fit seeds separate and keep the ensemble as a separate candidate
candidate_policy.other_families: Keep each of three saved fitted instances separate; do not average family metrics

seed_design.verification: Check protocol-declared seed labels and exact prediction content hashes; deterministic duplicates have no independent fit-seed replication

candidate_policy.fit_seed_stability: Rank each fit seed within its matched same-seed panel of seven model families, following the RES-281 per-seed family-panel diagnostic; exclude the separately reported ensemble. Report seed-wise ranks, rank range, distinct ranks, pairwise order reversals, and prediction identity count. Deterministic seed labels are not independent training replications.

ranking.ties: Exact numeric equality receives average ranks; no tolerance or post-hoc tie threshold
ranking.pairwise_reversal: Compare pairwise order across metric rankings; ties are counted separately and are not reversals
ranking.pareto: RMSE and MAE minimize; R² and SRE maximize; dominance requires no worse on all four and strictly better on at least one

paired_uncertainty.method: Entity-cluster bootstrap planned for the frozen IID validation population
paired_uncertainty.eligibility: Run only when canonical target truth rows and row-to-entity mapping are present in tracked public evidence; prediction row IDs alone do not qualify
paired_uncertainty.unit: inputs.entity_id; retain every row and all target/model predictions for each sampled entity
paired_uncertainty.interval: Percentile 95% average-rank interval and frequency attaining the best score; exact ties count jointly; planned only when evidence is available
paired_uncertainty.missing_evidence_policy: If tracked validation truth or row-to-entity mapping is absent, do not regenerate the dataset; mark UNSUPPORTED_BY_EVIDENCE and inference INCONCLUSIVE

prohibitions: No training, checkpoint mutation, or prediction regeneration
No historical fitted-model panel, ranking, correlation, or stability coefficient
No inference that benchmark chronology demonstrates model-ranking improvement
No private historical datasets, checkpoints, or outputs
